candidate_mining_contract.warning: Candidate filters and legacy model predictions must never be treated as positive or negative ground truth without Owner review.

position_policy: one image per candidate; the distance to the right edge is one of the Owner-frozen right_context_bars 0/8/16/24, chosen deterministically per candidate. Position diversity comes from real endpoints, not from re-showing the same pattern.

deduplication.source_endpoints: one window per (symbol, endpoint); overlapping windows rejected
deduplication.perceptual_threshold_anchor: same window shifted by one bar moves the hash ~18 bits
